data.value: Will at least 200 of the 5,000 newsletter subscribers Tidepool emails on launch morning click through to join the beta waitlist within 72 hours?

The newsletter has a typical click-through rate of 6%. The beta email is scheduled to be sent to all 5,000 subscribers at the start time. The email contains a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. Subscribers may or may not open the email, click the link, and join the waitlist.
